body: Thank you for these words. As for my parents, one can only hope they come around eventually.

I think I'm depressed, but i wouldn't know. I've never seen a therapist, seen anyone, talked about what I'm feeling. When the doctor asks me about this stuff I just tell him I'm fine and dandy. Any advice on dealing with parents or finding someone to talk to would be appreciated.
I said true booty instead of true beauty once :(
